Manifesto

We are a SEC-registered Philippine construction and trading company headquartered in Talisay City, Cebu. We supply steam coal, metallurgical coke, palm kernel shell, woodchips, and 16 metallic and non-metallic minerals to cement, sugar, and power-generation plants across the country. We build ports, plants, and civil works under our PCAB license. We charter the marine fleet that ships it all.

The objective of this company is to provide high quality construction and engineering services to Philippine industry that could help the national economic progress and development in the country. However, it has always the objective and the will to protect the environment and preserve life while using its resources wisely and prudently for the benefit of all mankind and the many generations to come.

01

Industrial fuels

The energy inputs that keep cement kilns, sugar mills, biomass power plants, and industrial boilers running across the country.

ECONARES supplies 4 primary industrial fuels at bulk scale, with quality/quantity inspection at load and discharge on every vessel. Source origins include Indonesia, Australia, South Africa, Malaysia, and Vietnam — selected per customer specification and current market price.

  • Steam Coal — 5,500–6,500 kcal/kg (ARB). Cement kilns.
  • Metallurgical Coke — 12% max. Ferro-alloy production.
  • Palm Kernel Shell (PKS) — 3,800–4,200 kcal/kg. Biomass power generation.
  • Woodchips — 2,800–3,500 kcal/kg. Biomass power generation.

03

Construction & engineering

PCAB-licensed horizontal and vertical works — from land development to industrial plant construction.

ECE Construction Services holds a Regular Contractor's License from the Philippine Contractors Accreditation Board, valid for both horizontal and vertical works. The full capabilities list covers 18 sub-services across three categories: engineering & construction, environmental protection, and marine services.

  • Land Development & Housing Works — Site grading, road networks, drainage, subdivision development, and housing construction.
  • Reclamation Projects — Coastal and offshore land reclamation with dredging, filling, and ground improvement.
  • Ports & Bridges — Port facilities, wharves, bridges, and marine infrastructure for commercial and industrial use.
  • Shipyards — Shipyard construction, dry-dock facilities, and marine repair infrastructure.
  • Industrial & Manufacturing Plant Construction — Cement, sugar, power, and manufacturing plant construction from foundation to commissioning.
  • Structural Steel Fabrication & Installation — Heavy steel fabrication and erection for industrial and commercial structures.
  • Commercial Buildings & Civil Works — Office, retail, mixed-use, and warehouse construction with full civil-works scope.
  • Electrical Works — Industrial and commercial electrical systems, substation, and power distribution.
  • Mechanical / Electromechanical Engineering — Mechanical installation, HVAC, plumbing, and electromechanical systems.
  • Cooling System / Ventilation Installation — Industrial cooling, ventilation, and air-handling system design and installation.
  • Water Treatment Facilities — Wastewater treatment plants, water filtration, and supply systems.
  • Deep Well & Water Supply Filtration — Deep-well drilling, pump installation, and water treatment/filtration systems.
  • Waste Water Treatment — Design, construction, and operation of industrial and municipal wastewater treatment plants.
  • Deep Well & Water Filtration — Deep-well construction and water filtration systems for industrial and community use.
  • Environmental Consultation — Environmental impact assessment, permitting, and compliance consulting.
  • LCT / Tug & Barge — Landing craft tank and tug-and-barge charter for bulk cargo and project cargo transport.
  • Vessel Piling Barge — Piling barge for wharf, bridge, and marine foundation piling works.
  • Crane Cutter Suction / 3-in-1 Dredger — Hydraulic cutter suction dredging for port deepening, reclamation, and channel maintenance.
  • Marine Survey — Hydrographic and bathymetric surveys for marine projects.

Reference projects

A selection of recent commodity shipments and construction engagements.

Republic Cement Coal Shipments — Bulk coal supply to Republic Cement operations — coal loading, trimming, quality/quantity inspection, and discharge at port.
